That's an excellent question! We definitely stand behind the quality of our products, and we're happy to provide details on our warranty policy.

For furniture and mattresses manufactured by DaVinci and purchased directly from us or our authorized retailers, we offer a manufacturer’s warranty.

Furniture: Your DaVinci furniture product is covered for 1 year from the date of purchase. This warranty protects you against damage resulting from a manufacturing defect and is non-transferrable from the original owner.
Mattresses: All contour and changer pads come with a 1-year limited warranty. For our mattresses, the warranty can be either two, ten, or twenty-five years, as specified by the individual item, from the date of purchase. This covers defects due to faulty workmanship or materials.

It's important to note that our warranty does not cover:

Damage from improper storage, installation, negligent misuse, or alterations made by the owner.
Normal wear and tear or commercial use.
Items bought as used or secondhand products (including floor models).
Items altered by an unauthorized 3rd party repair person.
For mattresses specifically, it doesn't cover normal everyday soiling, certain types of stains (non-food related grease, inks, cosmetics, bleach, alcohol, dyes, solvents, corrosives), intentional or accidental damage from misuse, or mattresses without the manufacturer's original law tag.

You can find more detailed information on our official warranty policy pages:

It's a great question to consider, and we aim to make returns as straightforward as possible! Here’s how our return process works:

Return Window & Conditions:
You can initiate a return within 30 days of delivery. If you purchased Checkout+ Protection, you get an extended window of 60 days.
Items must be in "like-new" condition, returned in their original boxes with all internal protective packaging, parts, pieces, and printed materials. They must not be modified in any way.
For mattresses, the original packaging must remain completely unopened and fully intact. Once the outer box of a Premium & Comfort Mattress is opened, or the plastic-wrapped packaging of a Deluxe Coil & Complete Slumber Mattress is unsealed, it's no longer eligible for return.
Please note that some items are generally ineligible for return or exchange, such as bedding products (though you can submit a request for review), Newton Baby Mattresses, gift cards, and items marked as “Final Sale.”
Initiating a Return:

All returns must be processed through our online portal. You can start your return or exchange by visiting our portal here: Start a Return or Exchange.

Return Shipping & Fees:
If you choose not to purchase return coverage, you will be responsible for the cost of the return shipping label and any associated return fees.
However, if you opted for Checkout+ Protection, you'll enjoy free return shipping with a prepaid label and a 100% refund of the purchase price once the item is received and processed.

Once your return arrives at our California facility, please allow 3–5 business days for inspection. Approved refunds are automatically issued to your original payment method.

We want you to feel confident and happy with your purchase, so we've designed our policy to be as flexible as possible!
